sidebar.deleteSessionBody: This permanently removes this conversation from OpenCraft. Project files on your computer won't be deleted.
sidebar.pickerFallback: Native picker unavailable; type a workspace path:
sidebar.removeWorkspaceBody: This only removes the project from the app. Files on your computer and existing chats won't be deleted.
sidebar.noAgentsHint: The assistant can create agents with create_agent
sidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset · ←/→ to nudge

welcome.title: Choose a workspace to start
welcome.body: OpenCraft works inside a project folder: files the assistant creates or changes live there. Pick a folder to begin — or open one from history in the sidebar.

advanced.noKnobs: This driver declares no extra knobs.
advanced.title: Advanced

config.agentsDeleteConfirm: Delete subagent {{name}}? In-flight delegations will be drained and the declaration removed.
config.agentsHint: Subagents are created by the assistant via the create_agent tool; this page lists and deletes them. Deleting drains in-flight delegations before removing the declaration.
config.diagHint: Environment, config, and runtime health. Operations below touch only opencraft-owned state.
config.diagPathDeployNote: A deployment that injects PATH through env_policy overrides this value for its own commands.
config.diagPathHint: Everything the app spawns inherits this PATH: MCP servers, agent commands, the gh/git lookups. A Finder/Dock launch gets launchd's minimal PATH instead of your shell's.
config.diagPathPrependLabel: Prepend directories (one absolute path per line)
config.diagPathReloadSkipped: PATH applied to new commands; the runtime reload did not run (see logs).
config.diagPathReloaded: Applied and runtime reloaded: MCP servers reconnect with the new PATH.
config.diagExecPoolHint: Controls the exec supervisor children: how many stay pre-warmed, how many idle children are kept, how many workspaces share a pooled child (beyond that a workspace gets its own child instead of being refused), and when idle children are recycled. Saving applies to future leases.
config.diagExecPoolRanges: Ranges: pre-warm 0–8 · max idle 0–16 · max active 1–64 · idle 1–60 minutes; out-of-range values move to the nearest bound.
config.diagPolicy: Check whether a command would run without approval:
config.diagPolicyAsk: Not allowed: would ask for approval
config.diagRepairCompatDone_one: Removed {{count}} obsolete config declaration: {{paths}}. Reload the runtime to apply.
config.diagRepairCompatDone_other: Removed {{count}} obsolete config declarations: {{paths}}. Reload the runtime to apply.
config.diagTelemetryHint: Where the app ships logs, traces and metrics. Capability plugins that declare telemetry:export may point this export at their own collector; credentials stay in host memory and the local log file below is always kept.
config.generalDefaultModeHint: The sandbox mode new sessions start in.
config.generalDefaultThinkHint: Think level used for new sessions; it only matters when the active model supports reasoning.
config.generalNewSessionDefaultsHint: Applies to sessions created after this changes; existing sessions are unaffected.
config.generalYoloConfirmIntro: Every new session will start with the sandbox disabled. OpenCraft will no longer ask for permission and can:
config.generalYoloConfirmScope: Only sessions created afterwards are affected; existing sessions stay unchanged and you can switch back to Workspace or Read-only in the composer at any time.
config.importIntro: Import conversations from other AI apps into the current workspace. Sources contributed by plugins appear below.
config.inferenceKeyCacheHint: Provider prompt caches are scoped to the credential as well as the model: after a key change the next request re-reads the whole conversation at full input price once.
config.mcpCommandRequired: Command is required for stdio servers.
config.mcpDiscoverHint: Official reference servers from modelcontextprotocol/servers. Add prefills a row — test before saving.
config.mcpHint: Attach external MCP tool servers; their tools are discovered lazily through tool_search. Write a command the way you would in a terminal: it runs with the app's PATH (Settings > Diagnostics > Process PATH).
config.mcpSaveHint: Adding or removing a row only changes this list until you save.
config.mcpSearchHint: Adding a GitHub repo tries to infer the run command from package.json / pyproject.toml / README; if it stays empty, fill it from the repo README.
config.mcpStatusConnectingHint: First connect or background retry; tools are invisible until connected
config.mcpURLRequired: Server URL is required for http servers.
config.memoryHint: Tune how conversation history enters the model context. Full history replay is experimental and relies on model window metadata from the router (Azure does not declare it yet).
config.memoryReplayHint: Inject the full conversation and fold only when estimated usage exceeds the model window. Keep off for bounded per-turn cost.
config.metricsEmpty: No samples yet — they appear once the app has been used for a while.
config.metricsHint: Local metric samples kept for 30 days (user.db). Charts refresh when you change the range.
config.modelNeedsChatForVideo: {{model}} accepts video input: switch this instance's API mode to chat and enable "Accept video blocks" under Advanced.
config.modelNeedsVideoInput: {{model}} accepts video input: enable "Accept video blocks" under Advanced.
config.escalatedHint: Commands allowed to run outside the sandbox. A matching command skips the sandbox and the approval prompt entirely — only commands you trust completely belong here.
config.permissionsEmptyHint: Commands outside the allowlist ask you for approval; approve once to add them here, or add one manually below.
config.permissionsHint: Sandbox allowlist (static rules + dynamic approvals from .opencraft/approvals.yaml)
config.permissionsPlaceholder: e.g. git status or python main.py
config.petDiagEmpty: No pet diagnostics yet (desktop pet disabled or window not started).
config.petEnabledHint: Show the assistant as a desktop pet that stays on your screen. It reacts to thinking, tool runs, answers, and prompts.
config.pluginsBuiltinHint: Built-in plugins ship with the app; they cannot be uninstalled, only disabled
config.pluginsCapabilitiesWarning: Hooks and tools can execute commands and read agent data; only enable plugins you trust.
config.pluginsEmpty: No plugins installed. Drop a plugin into ~/.opencraft/plugins/<id>/ and refresh.
config.pluginsInstallHint: Pick a folder containing plugin.json or a zip package; it takes effect immediately.
config.pluginsNoCapabilities: This plugin contributes no agent capabilities.
config.pluginsPermissionsEmpty: This plugin declares no host permissions.
config.pluginsRollbackBody: Restores the version you had before the last update. The current version is discarded; the plugin's enable state, settings and data are kept.
config.pluginsShadowHint: This user plugin overrides the built-in plugin with the same id (built-in v{{version}}). Uninstall it to restore the built-in.
config.pluginsShadowInstallTooOld: Version {{version}} is older than the built-in {{builtinVersion}}; install will be rejected.
config.pluginsShadowInstallWarn: This plugin will override the built-in {{name}} (built-in v{{builtinVersion}}); uninstalling it later restores the built-in.
config.pluginsShadowOlder: User version {{version}} is older than the built-in {{builtinVersion}}
config.pluginsToolsEmpty: This plugin declares no agent tools.
config.pluginsUninstallBody: Removes the plugin folder and deletes the data, secrets and inference profiles it registered. Its tools, skills and MCP servers stop being available.
config.pluginsUpdateHint: Select the new version folder or zip. The previous version is kept for rollback.

router.fallback: Fall back to the next target
router.title: Router retry policy

config.searchHint: Try a feature name, or a word from a label (“font”, “OTLP”, “MCP”, “sandbox”).
config.skillsDeleteConfirm: Delete skill {{name}}? Its directory will be removed; builtin skills cannot be deleted.
config.skillsDiscoverHint: Official skills from the openai/codex repo. Install clones and validates them.
config.skillsHint: Discovered skills (the assistant can find and use them via skill_search / skill_read)
config.skillsImportHint: Install a skill from a git repo or local path; it becomes available immediately.
config.skillsImportRepoRequired: Enter a git URL or local path

toolFieldDesc.aspect_ratio: Pins the output shape; conflicts with a per-call size.
toolFieldDesc.background: Output transparency; needs a format that carries alpha.
toolFieldDesc.callback_url: Provider POSTs task updates here after a challenge handshake.
toolFieldDesc.camera_fixed: Keep the camera static while the subject moves.
toolFieldDesc.fast_pretreatment: Shorten the prompt optimizer's rewrite time.
toolFieldDesc.generate_audio: Let the model synthesize a matching audio track.
toolFieldDesc.guidance_scale: Prompt adherence, must be positive. Newer Seedream models ignore it.
toolFieldDesc.input_fidelity: How hard the model tries to match an input image (edit requests).
toolFieldDesc.layer_decomposition: Split the input image into editable layers; needs an input image and resolution sizing.
toolFieldDesc.omni_reference_task_type: Hints which omni-reference subtask to run.
toolFieldDesc.optimize_prompt_mode: standard rewrites more thoroughly, fast returns sooner.
toolFieldDesc.optimize_prompt_thinking: Whether the prompt optimizer runs its thinking stage.
toolFieldDesc.output_compression: WebP/JPEG compression level; needs one of those formats.
toolFieldDesc.priority: Higher raises the queue position, range 0-9.
toolFieldDesc.prompt_optimizer: Let the provider rewrite the prompt before generating.
toolFieldDesc.safety_identifier: Stable per-user identifier the provider can apply policy to.
toolFieldDesc.sequential: Return a set of related images in one call.
toolFieldDesc.sequential_max_images: Group size, 1-15; only with grouped generation.
toolFieldDesc.service_tier: Serving tier; flex is cheaper and slower.
toolFieldDesc.size_token: Named size tier instead of explicit dimensions.
toolFieldDesc.watermark: Ask the provider to stamp an AIGC watermark.
toolFieldDesc.web_search: Attach the provider's hosted web search.

config.toolsImageHint: Settings for the image generation tool. They apply to the provider they are configured on; the tool's common parameters stay per call.
config.toolsHint: Tools the agent can call. Provider-specific settings live on each tool; the model-facing surface keeps the common parameters.
config.toolsNoFields: This provider has no provider-specific options.
config.toolsNoInstances: No enabled deployment serves this output yet.
config.toolsVideoHint: Settings for the video generation tool. They apply to the provider they are configured on; the tool's common parameters stay per call.
config.webSearchHint: Adds a web_search tool the model discovers on demand. The keyless Parallel/Exa endpoints work out of the box; add your own Tavily or Brave key for stable quotas.
config.webSearchKeySet: Key stored in the credential store
config.webSearchPrivacy: Queries are sent to the selected provider; the free tiers may be used to improve their services. Keys are stored in the credential store, never in the config file.
config.webSearchTestNeedsKey: Add an API key before testing
config.title: Settings
config.uiCloseToTrayHint: Keep running in the system tray, or quit entirely. On macOS the close button hides the app in the menu bar by default.
config.uiFontsHint: The interface font and text size apply to the whole app; the code font covers code blocks, diffs and the file viewer. Only fonts installed on this machine can be used.
config.uiFontUnavailable: This platform does not expose its font list; only the system default is available.
config.uiFontPreviewSans: The quick brown fox 字体预览 0123
config.uiThemeHint: Dark keeps the terminal look; Light suits bright environments; Auto follows the system appearance.
config.usageCacheHitHint: cache-read tokens ÷ prompt tokens, cache reads included (lifetime, all models). Rows recorded before prompt tokens became inclusive cannot state a ratio and show a dash.
config.usageHint: Token usage per model across all workspaces and sessions.
config.usageLatencyLegacyHint: Cumulative latency; call count is unavailable for pre-migration data.
config.usageRangeInvalid: End time must be after start time.
config.usageSeriesEmpty: No time-bucketed usage recorded for this model yet.
config.usageSeriesEmptyRange: No usage recorded in this range.
config.heapProfileHint: Forces a GC and writes a pprof heap profile for offline analysis (go tool pprof -inuse_space). Capture one when a long session looks heavy.
config.diagSecRuntimeHint: Command pool, process PATH, telemetry export and heap snapshots.

chat.modelSwitchCost: Switched to {{model}}. Prompt caches are scoped to the model, so this conversation's next request re-reads the transcript at full input price once.
chat.compactionFoldedDetail: Older rounds were folded into a summary: the turn kept running with a shorter history. The prompt prefix changed, so the next request is billed at full input price once.
chat.compactionStrained: Context compaction is out of options
chat.compactionStrainedDetail: This conversation is close to the model's input window and automatic folding cannot reduce it further ({{count}} failed attempt(s) standing). Prefer shorter tool output and finish the step in flight; start a new conversation for a fresh window.
chat.foldedSteps: {{count}} earlier steps folded (full trail in the session archive)
chat.newChatWorkspace: New chat goes to the selected workspace
chat.liveWithoutHistory: History unavailable — live output continues below
chat.placeholderUnconfigured: Start chatting after finishing the inference setup
chat.workspaceBanner: Commands and file access stay inside the workspace; commands outside the allowlist ask for approval
chat.readOnlyBanner: Known read commands run without approval; writes blocked by the sandbox
chat.yoloBanner: Sandbox disabled — commands run directly on the host with no approval prompts
chat.yoloConfirmIntro: YOLO applies only to this conversation. After switching, OpenCraft stops asking for permission and can:
chat.yoloConfirmFilesBody: Read, modify, or delete files at any path on this computer — no longer limited to the workspace.
chat.yoloConfirmTerminalBody: Run commands directly on the host with the full environment; allowlists and approval prompts no longer apply.
chat.yoloConfirmNetworkBody: Reach any website, API, or private/internal address without domain-policy or SSRF restrictions.
chat.yoloConfirmScope: This only affects the current conversation; you can switch back to Workspace or Read-only at any time.
chat.lastCancelledDetail: You stopped this reply before it finished.
chat.forkTurnBody: A new session will copy the history up to this reply and open it, so you can continue from this point.
chat.interruptedHostShutdown: App closed or config changed; the task was interrupted
chat.interruptedUserInput: New input arrived; the task was interrupted
chat.lastInterruptedDetail: This reply was interrupted before it finished.
chat.lastFailedDetail: This reply failed before it finished.
chat.providerFailure: The model service couldn't complete this request. Try again or switch models.
chat.invalidProviderResponse: The model returned an unexpected response. Try again or switch models.
chat.modelConfiguration: The model configuration looks invalid. Check your model settings.
chat.invalidRequest: The model provider rejected this request. Check your model settings and try again.
chat.turnTimeout: This turn timed out before it finished. Try again, or split the work into smaller steps.
chat.genericFailure: The reply failed while running. Try again.
chat.queued: Queued — “{{preview}}” sends when the current reply ends
chat.queuedReady: Queued — “{{preview}}” (reply ended; press Enter to send)
chat.queuedInterrupt: Queued — “{{preview}}” will interrupt once the new reply starts
chat.bargeWaiting: Interrupting the current reply — “{{preview}}” will be sent next
chat.busyKeyHint: Enter steers the reply (delivered before the next step) · Tab sends after it ends
chat.steerAttachments: Steering carries text only — Tab to queue the attachments, or stop the reply first
chat.steerRejected: The steer was not delivered — the turn stopped accepting messages; the draft is kept
chat.steerUndelivered: Steer not delivered (the turn ended before it was picked up)
chat.messagePeekNoContent: This turn has no text yet.

files.viewerChunkFailed: The preview module failed to load. Try again, or open the file with the system app.

setup.effortMapIncomplete: Effort map must define all five canonical levels (minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh)
setup.endpoint: Deployment ID, e.g. ep-xxx (blank addresses by model name)
setup.maxInputHint: Declared input-context window of this model. Leave empty to publish no limit: opencraft's compaction node then falls back to its own budget (128k by default), and the runtime rejects no request on this model's behalf.
setup.routerPriority: Routing priority (top first, automatic fallback on failure)
setup.subtitle: Select the providers you have keys for and order them by priority; the config is written to ~/.opencraft/config/opencraft.yaml
setup.title: Inference setup
setup.webSearchHint: Requires upstream support (OpenAI Responses, DeepSeek V4 Pro, ByteDance Ark). Chat-surface and unsupported models ignore it; every generate model in this deployment has to allow it too.
